data.name: Step1_Description
data.value:
Select or create an **AI provider** and configure its API key and default model. Set the base URL if required. Leave **Model override** empty to use the default.
Requests and input data are sent to that provider.

data.name: Step2_Headline
data.value: Write the prompt and define the output

data.name: Step2_Description
data.value:
Enter the task in **Prompt**. Use the **field selection button** to insert input fields into your prompt. FlowBlox fills in their current values when the block runs.
Use **System instruction** for general rules and the requested response format. The default instruction requests **JSON**; you can adapt it for other formats.
For example: ask the model to extract a title and a short summary from the referenced input text.

data.name: Option_Completed_Description
data.value: Tracks whether the AI Prompt quick-start guidance has been completed.
